analysis:
Speaking to reporters outside Parliament on 15 December 2022, the Union Health Minister said there had been a 71 per cent increase in medical colleges, from 387 before 2014 to 660, along with an 87 per cent rise in MBBS seats and a 105 per cent rise in PG seats over eight years.

Government material published since is consistent: a PIB document records medical colleges rising about 70 per cent, from 387 in 2014 to 660 in 2023, with AIIMS rising from 7 to 22. Mint reported the Health Ministry stating a 71 per cent increase in medical colleges and a 97 per cent rise in MBBS seats, from 51,348 before 2014 to 101,043.

Different outlets quote slightly different percentage rises for MBBS and PG seats depending on the comparison date, but the college counts and the direction of change match official figures.
notes: This measures medical colleges, a different metric from the excluded modi-2021-medical-seats-60000-added claim (which concerned medical seats). Percentages for MBBS/PG seats vary across reports (87%/105% in the minister's December 2022 statement; 97% in later ministry figures) depending on base year. The PIB PDF date is set to 2023-05-01 because only the month is indicated by the URL.
